description: NaPr₄N₂I₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six I atoms. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.08-3.52 Å. There are four inequivalent Pr sites. In the first Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and four I atoms. Both Pr-N bond lengths are 2.33 Å. There are a spread of Pr-I bond distances ranging from 3.18-3.47 Å. In the second Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two N and four I atoms. Both Pr-N bond lengths are 2.34 Å. There are a spread of Pr-I bond distances ranging from 3.15-3.42 Å. In the third Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and six I atoms. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) Pr-N bond length. There are a spread of Pr-I bond distances ranging from 3.24-3.99 Å. In the fourth Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and five I atoms. Both Pr-N bond lengths are 2.36 Å. There are a spread of Pr-I bond distances ranging from 3.24-3.97 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to four Pr atoms to form edge-sharing NPr₄ tetrahedra. In the second N site, N is bonded to four Pr atoms to form edge-sharing NPr₄ tetrahedra. There are seven inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Pr atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na and four Pr atoms. In the third I site, I is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Pr atoms. In the fourth I site, I is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Pr atoms. In the fifth I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Pr atoms. In the sixth I site, I is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Pr atoms. In the seventh I site, I is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Pr atoms.
